title: HelperSSHForwardParams
description: Ask the far side for a LISTENER: the tcpip-forward request of a remote forward (-R) and the transport the remote lifecycle channel rides (ADR-0024). It is its own op rather than a `kind` of `open` because the two leave different things behind and are ended by different ops — a channel is one stream a caller holds, a listener is a stream FACTORY whose accepted connections arrive as channels nobody asked for by name (nocx-50w7p.8).

destination.description: The connection the listener is requested on, and what to authenticate as: the same resolved triple `open` takes, resolved by the coordinator for the same reason (alias resolution, ~/.ssh/config merging and the credential's authorization against an endpoint stay there).

bind.description: The address to listen on, on the FAR side. Port 0 asks the server to allocate, which is the ordinary request: a fixed port is a policy question (PermitListen) and an allocation is not. The host is a request and not a promise — a server may rebind a non-loopback bind to loopback (GatewayPorts) without a word to the client — so what was bound is reported back rather than assumed.

acceptOnTrust.description: The coordinator's answer to 'may a host key this host has never presented be recorded', carried here for the same reason probe and open carry it: this op may be the first contact with a host, and the helper may not decide that for itself.
